notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added inventory
[*] Added new achievements
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera could get stuck in the running state
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
[b]List of changes:
[/b]

[list]
[*] The story text at the beginning and end of the game now changes with a key press instead of a simple slideshow.
[*] General puzzle improvements. Added a few hints and made some of the existing ones clearer and less obscure.
[*] Slightly increased visible distance and brightness in complete darkness.
[*] Fixed an issue where some buttons could get stuck in the hover state in the pause menu.
[*] A few translation fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the player can see key bindings in the options.
[*] Changed options panel.
[*] Improved the bookshelf hint to make it less obscure.
[*] A few more minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
[b]List of changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased battery lifetime.
[*] Slightly increased visible distance and brightness in complete darkness.
[*] Added more batteries (2 per level).
[*] Some key items are now easier to find.
[*] Fixed camera movement bug when paused.
[*] Added missing SFX to vending machine.
[*] Some other minor fixes
[/list]
